title: Branch \& Price \& Cut for the Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (TDVRPTW)
summary: In urban contexts, travel times vary strongly with the time of day and traffic conditions. The Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (TDVRPTW) extends the classical VRPTW by making travel times depend on departure time, with the objective of minimizing the total travel time of at most $k$ vehicle routes serving customers within strict time windows. Exact resolution of this realistic yet understudied problem currently relies on the Branch \& Price approach of Dabia et al.
